decisions.reason: The award and the strong fit with the firm's existing materials and system expertise suggest high absorptive capacity and a good chance to refine and commercialize this product further.

Although there is little visible market evidence after launch, the product builds on established geothermal and tube-related know-how, so the firm is likely to retain it while learning from early customer use.
As a surface technology line closely linked to the firm's existing geothermal offering and materials competence, it is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

This fire-protection steel profile system is very close to the firm's core building-systems business, making it a natural candidate to keep and develop through existing technical and customer knowledge.
The slim steel profile system is closely related to the established profile and construction business, so the firm likely sees enough learning and cross-selling potential to continue it.

Because the decorative steel profile surface system extends the firm's established profile solutions and customization capabilities, management would probably keep it and adapt it to customer demand rather than exit quickly.
